verdict.rationale: Firecrawl sends webhooks when a crawl, batch scrape, extract, agent job or monitor check starts, progresses or finishes. Delivery is HMAC-signed, so users can trigger downstream actions automatically from these events. However, the evidence shows only outbound event notifications to an HTTPS endpoint the user must host, with no in-product rule definition or action engine. missing for 10: user-defined rule/condition configuration, built-in automated actions triggered by events, documentation of monitor rule setup, independent corroboration.
